assets.title: Autoshop 01 (2k EXR, night-graded and prefiltered)
assets.author: Oliksiy Yakovlyev (Poly Haven)

source.title: Autoshop 01 HDRI, Poly Haven
source.note: Downloaded from https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/HDRIs/exr/2k/autoshop_01_2k.exr, the 2k EXR listed by https://api.polyhaven.com/files/autoshop_01. Bytes unchanged. MD5 a4f4d82741636c37c4a31860c2ad1f6a matches the API; SHA-256 93f15df7efeeb7e5913b07f15adcecc41b9adbd9f25ea2213e9d8e8adcf81c00. API info: author Oliksiy Yakovlyev, white balance 5050 K, categories indoor / artificial light / low contrast. Poly Haven's licence page (https://polyhaven.com/license) says all its assets are CC0.

assets.credit: Autoshop 01 by Oliksiy Yakovlyev, Poly Haven (CC0)
assets.notes: Used for image-based lighting and reflections only, never as a visible background. Chosen over garage, auto_service and workshop because it is a car workshop lit by fluorescent strips at 5050 K, close to our 5000 K strips; the others are daylight-lit or mixed. CC0 needs no credit, but /credits will name it anyway. Shipped as a derived file since 2026-09-30: scripts/bake-environment.ts takes the EXR above (kept out of git in assets-raw/env/, SHA-256 checked), applies the night grade, box-filters it to 512 x 256 and prefilters it with three's own PMREMGenerator into a 384 x 512 cube-UV atlas (128 px cube), stored as RGB9E5 and gzipped. The bake checks itself against three's runtime prefilter on WebGPU and WebGL 2.
